options.fxglobals.title: FX Globals
options.fxglobals.day_length.tooltip: How long one day-night cycle lasts, against vanilla's 20 minutes. 100% is vanilla.
options.fxglobals.hunger.tooltip: How fast the hunger bar drains. 100% is vanilla, 0% never drains.
options.fxglobals.pickup_arrows.tooltip: Collect every arrow lying in the world, including the ones mobs shot. Off is vanilla, where only your own arrows come back.
options.fxglobals.headshots.tooltip: An arrow landing at or above a mob's eyes kills it instantly. Does not affect players.
options.fxglobals.starter_gear.tooltip: New players get a postbote satchel, a camera with 24 papers, a photo album, a compass, a lodestone, a white flag, climbing claws, plush boots, a backpack and a recipe book on first join.
